svg.title: diffdevil brand glyphs in the GitHub Changed trigger
svg.desc: Three monochrome brand-derived candidates and the existing full-colour micro symbol shown immediately before Changed on light and dark GitHub-like surfaces.
svg.text: Target context Â· subtle diffdevil identity
The monochrome default and full-colour option should read as the same product at different emphasis, not as unrelated feature icons.
